moa.identity: orange fox Moa, paper-patch explorer coat, large OPEN brown eyes
moa.scene: A premium paper-garden atelier. Moa sits behind a low desk with an open sketchbook and a tiny CLOSED die-cut paper door lying flat on its page. One paw rests beside the door tab, the other rests on the desk. A paper pencil lies unused. Nothing floats. Warm miniature garden light barely visible along the closed door seam. The door is chest-width and well below the face. Medium full-body portrait with stable table and room, not the towering doorway of the reference.
moa.outbound: Moa gently lifts the small paper door by its tab with one paw, keeping the other on the desk. A miniature leafy garden glows inside the open door. Moa leans forward and slightly to the side, OPEN eyes directed into the low paper doorway. Stop in a clear admiring pose with the door open.
moa.return: Moa gently withdraws the head, closes the paper door with the same paw, and places that paw back beside the tab. Garden light dims to the initial seam glow. Ease into the exact starting open-eyed pose. No reverse playback.

root.identity: small deer Root, cream face, small antlers, green gold-trimmed guide cape
root.scene: A forest wayfinding pavilion, Root behind a low terrain-map table. One rigid short wooden pointer held in one hoof-hand, its tip near the map; the other hoof-hand rests on the table. Two faintly lit fixed route paths lead toward a meeting point on the map. Two small woodland companions wait far behind, paws down, not touching the table. Corresponding small sign lamps along the background forest path. Guide and map dominate, clear headroom and no letters.
root.outbound: Root leans over the map and moves the one rigid pointer along two existing routes to their meeting point. Warm route lights trace the paths and the corresponding background lamps brighten in sequence. Root makes a modest head turn toward the waiting companions, smiling and indicating the meeting point. Keep the pointer a single rigid piece.
root.return: Root looks back toward the map, returns the pointer and hoof-hand to the initial position. Route lights and background lamps gently return to their original dim brightness, without changing map geometry. Root returns to the exact starting posture. Companions only give a small nod.

pico.identity: green chameleon Pico, curled tail, warm brown eyes, backward coral cap, aurora-pattern craft clothes
pico.scene: A rich aurora textile studio. Pico stands behind a low workbench with two small translucent colored fabric panels mounted separately in simple rectangular frames on one horizontal sliding rail. They are NOT overlapping yet. One front paw lightly holds the handle of the right panel; the other rests on the bench. A neutral parchment screen behind the bench catches the colored shadows. Both panels remain below the face; body color stays green. Medium portrait, stable props, no loose cloth held aloft.
pico.outbound: Pico slides the right rigid fabric frame left along its rail with one paw until the translucent panels overlap. A new colored pattern appears in their overlap and on the parchment screen. Pico visibly inclines the head and upper body toward that pattern, looking at its actual position below eye level. Tail remains curled.
pico.return: Pico slides the same frame right back to its original separate position; overlapping color splits naturally into the two original shadows. The moving paw and head return to the reference pose. Keep both frames, rail, tail and green body shape unchanged.

sori.identity: cream fennec fox Sori, very large ears, cream embroidered storyteller robe, gentle brown eyes
sori.scene: An intimate luminous storybook library. Sori sits at a low reading desk with ONE open book resting flat, showing three simple painted panels: seed, sapling and tree, with muted colors and no writing. Both front paws clearly visible, one poised beside the first panel and the other resting at the book edge. No floating pages or extra characters. Warm book lanterns, tactile storybook 3D, face unobscured.
sori.outbound: Sori traces the three picture panels in order with one paw, moving the head and gaze to match each picture below the face. The panels regain rich color and glow in sequence; a tiny painted tree within the last panel sways. Sori gives a small satisfied nod, as if finishing an explanation. No talking or lip-sync required.
sori.return: Sori lifts the tracing paw slightly and naturally returns it to the first panel while following with the gaze. The extra glow and vivid color softly subside in sequence to the reference's muted pictures; no new drawings or text. Relax into the exact original pose.

melo.identity: cream-and-orange kitten Melo, peach headphones, lavender cape, exactly two front paws
melo.outbound: Melo perks one ear and makes a clear curious head tilt toward the stationary cocoa mug. A ribbon of steam curls like a question, then briefly resembles a tiny translucent vapor whale above the mug, to the viewer-right of the face. Melo follows it with eyes and a small head movement at the whale's actual height. Both paws remain on the table. End admiring the vapor whale, face unobscured.

Melo's eyes follow it only while visible, then head and ears return slowly to the exact initial pose. Mug and two paws stay fixed. No third paw, no touching the headphones, no looking at the ceiling.

talk.scene: A cozy star-lit miniature radio studio. Talk sits behind a small desk, one paw near a simple physical toggle switch, other paw resting. Exactly two fixed tabletop microphones: one for Talk and one for a small cream bunny guest opposite at viewer-left. Talk's lamp is softly on, guest's lamp off. Guest hands stay on its side of the desk. No clipboard, no writing, no third character. Clear faces and modest room depth.
talk.outbound: Talk finishes a small introductory gesture and uses one paw to toggle the guest's microphone light on and own light off. Talk visibly turns head and upper body toward the bunny and listens with a gentle nod. Bunny gives a small head response, hands resting. No speech, text or exaggerated mouth movement.
talk.return: The bunny finishes its nod. Talk acknowledges with a small smile, turns back toward own microphone and toggles the lights to the initial state using the same paw. Paw, torso and head settle back to the exact first-frame pose. Both microphones stay rigid and stationary.

leaf.identity: cream-yellow cockatiel Leaf, coral-tipped upright crest, orange cheek patches, plum market coat
leaf.scene: An enchanting seed market stall. Leaf stands on two bird feet beside a low counter, both feathered wings relaxed at its sides. One compact seed pinwheel device with four folded wooden petal blades sits fixed on the counter below the bird's beak, with a small crank. A single tiny squirrel vendor stands behind the device, one paw near crank, other resting. Warm market lights; no other foreground character, no human hands on the bird.
leaf.outbound: Leaf leans forward and makes an inquisitive head tilt toward the device. The squirrel vendor rotates the one crank with one paw; the four EXISTING seed petals rotate together gently around their one fixed axle, showing their seed-filled bowls. Leaf's crest rises a little, eyes tracking the device below the beak. Keep the existing four-petal shape intact, no extra blade or object grabbing by the bird.
leaf.return: The vendor releases the crank. The four existing petals slow to a stop in the original orientation. Leaf withdraws slightly, lowers the crest and returns to the initial posture. Vendor paw returns to its starting crank position. Preserve exactly four petals, one axle and two bird wings. No folding or changing the blade shapes.

tori.identity: brown beaver Tori, cream muzzle and two small front teeth, navy workshop apron, small fixed brass monocle
tori.scene: A moon-clock craftsman's workshop. A small clock mechanism is flat on a low workbench with two fixed gears and one obvious empty gear socket. Tori holds ONE matching third gear just above that socket with the viewer-right paw, other paw resting at the mechanism's edge. A small crescent-moon ornament rests low on an attached vertical guide. No other loose gears or floating objects. All hands and working parts visible below the face.
tori.outbound: Tori looks between the socket and the held gear, places the one gear carefully into the socket and withdraws the paw. Three gears rotate in place around their original fixed axes, lifting the small moon ornament along its short guide. Tori leans in and follows the mechanism with a pleased attentive gaze at table level.
tori.return: The gears slow and stop as the moon ornament lowers to its original location. Only after the gears stop, Tori picks up the same third gear with the same paw and holds it at the original position above the socket. Other paw stays anchored. Return head and eyes to the starting pose; never duplicate teeth, gears or paws.

mong.identity: raccoon Mong, gray fur with dark eye mask, teal inventor jacket, brass goggles resting on forehead
mong.scene: A magical inventor's greenhouse workbench. ONE small terracotta flowerpot with a simple green seedling rests on a round base at desk level. A short brass lever is fixed beside the base. Mong's viewer-left paw rests on the lever grip, other paw rests on the tabletop. Goggles remain on forehead. No floating tools, robots or other foreground objects. mong.outbound: Mong deliberately switches the one lever with the gripping paw. The one pot rises only a few centimeters above its base. Mong leans to one side and bends the head down to inspect the gap, then looks at the gently turning leaves with a delighted smile. The pot stays below the face, shape and leaf count unchanged.
mong.return: Mong returns the same lever to its initial position. The pot gently descends onto the base and leaves settle to their initial orientation. Mong watches the landing at its true position, then returns both head and moving paw to the exact reference posture. Never touch the goggles or add a paw.

block.return: First Tori picks up the stationary marble with one paw, places it back in its original left starting groove, and withdraws that paw. Only then Tori lifts the connector plank with both paws and returns it to the original hovering position above the gap. Block continues steadying the left support. Both faces return to their starting directions. Clear sequential handling, no simultaneous marble-and-plank grab, no teleportation.

joy.scene: A cozy cloud bakery. Joy stands at viewer-left behind a low table and Mong at viewer-right. Joy gently smooths the central dough back into the original round ball and rotates the plate back. Both return paws and gazes to the reference positions. No magically vanishing dough pieces.

pace.return: Pace looks back to the starting stone, makes a small natural body turn, walks one short step back and turns to the exact initial facing direction. bani.identity: white rabbit Bani, two long ears, teal travel cape with ribbon, small green backpack

skip.identity: round cheerful quokka Skip in coral festival costume, short rounded ears

Exactly two small seated woodland friends at the back, hands down, with a low string of dim warm festival bulbs. skip.return: Skip makes a small side-step back to the exact starting foot positions, lowers the inviting paw and settles from the sway with a visible relaxed breath.
